notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantmanets.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
